query: Create a defensible spatial train/validation/test plan for the small study area [13.30,52.35,13.50,52.50] west,south,east,north. First identify its setting by calling reverse_geocode_place with latitude=52.425, longitude=13.40, zoom=10. Call evaluate_spatial_autocorrelation with raster_path='/private/tmp/eo-spatial-split-2021.tif', band_index=1, lag_m=2560, seed=3, n_pairs_per_lag=200000, n_bins=24, max_lag_m=12800. Then call plan_spatial_split with raster_path equal to the evaluator's artifacts.analysis_band path, band_index=1, buffer_m=null (or omit buffer_m for automatic guard), lag_m=2560, seed=3, patch_layout='reference_blocks', patch_size_pixels=[32,40], block_size_pixels=[96,120], edge_policy='extend', seed_candidates=200, group_assignment='compact_regions', buffer_policy='one_sided', and split_ratios=[0.7,0.1,0.2]. Omit n_patches. Use seeded compact split regions in both spatial directions and extract fixed rectangular patches, adapting the checkpoint scripts/04_extract_patches.py workflow. Report requested versus realized fractions and the ranked seed selection. Class coverage remains unverified because no categorical labels are provided to this MCP call; never claim all classes occur in every split. Report the paired unbuffered mask with exactly the same validation/test rectangles and restored training rectangles. Guards retain test, then validation, then training, and exclude only conflicting lower-priority patches. The candidate mask has every quality-eligible patch before buffering and different heldout support. This is a geometric demonstration of the requested gap, including when the scientific lag decision rejects it. Report an infeasible split accurately if this AOI cannot support that guard. Report the actual scene/band or raster used, variogram-derived rho_at_lag, practical_range_m, nugget, sill, fit_rss, per-bin count reliability, and the two-condition decision. Accept the lag only when rho_at_lag<0.1 AND lag_m>=practical_range_m with a resolved fit. Report patch counts before/after the buffer, candidate coverage, unselected valid pixels, excluded training pixels, and geometric separation. Keep unselected coverage separate from pixels removed by the buffer. This live integration test does not train a segmentation model; do not invent model accuracy. Distinguish observed results from recommendations, identify tool failures, and cite each tool. Explain that this unsupervised image analysis cannot establish a downstream model's prediction accuracy. Keep the answer concise.
answer: The study area is Berlin, Germany. The variogram analysis of the raster band at 2560 m lag shows a practical range of 521.49 m, with ρ = 0.042 (below the 0.1 threshold), accepting the lag. The 1298.24 m buffer (twice the practical range) is also accepted (ρ = 0.084). The compact block grid retained 77.2% of valid pixels after buffering, with realized split fractions of 55.8% train, 9.7% validation, and 34.4% test. The minimum footprint gap between splits is 1508.73 m. Seed 10 maximized retained quality pixels. The paired unbuffered mask restores training patches while keeping validation/test identical. Class coverage is unverified.
